30-second full SDK HTTP operation including redirects, 5-second connection/TLS/CONNECT waits, 256KiB body, 32KiB request/response head and 100 fields, 1MiB body. Headers-only challenge returns from an infinite SSE header without awaiting body and closes the socket. The connection driver/exchange are polled in one owned future; cancellation, rejected/oversized proxy and timeout close sockets with no direct fallback or automatic origin replay.
